definition: [ מְחָא ] verb smite (see Biblical Hebrew II. מָחָה ); — Pe`al Perfect 3 feminine singular מְחַת , ל of thing, Dan 2:34 ; Dan 2:35 (+ עַל ). Pa`el Imperfect 3 masculine singular ימַחֵא בִידֵהּ Dan 4:32 , i.e. hinder him (compare Eccl 8:4 ᵑ7 ; D Aramaic Dialektproben. p. 5 ; Talmud: Levy NHWB under the word ). Hithpa. Imperfect 3 masculine singular יִתְמְחֵא Ezra 6:11 let him be smitten (nailed) עֲלֹ֑הִי . [ מַחְלְקָה ] see חלק .
